title: Michelson-Morley ether experiments

tellings.quote: you have the Michaelson Morley experiments of the 1890s where you know they did a set of these sort of optical detections

plain: Michels brings up the Michelson-Morley experiments, which he places in the 1890s, as a set of optical measurements meant to detect the ether, the invisible medium once thought to carry light. He tells it himself, without naming a source, in a conversation with a scientist named Rupert Sheldrake. He offers it as an example of science testing an idea about the hidden fabric of the world.
